title: Where you open matters

captions.instagram:
Where you open is a real estate decision before it's a retail one.

Location, lease, traffic, buildout. After the Wiz, I took that same eye to land, assembling underutilized parcels across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and New Jersey.

Save the 5 questions before you sign a lease.

captions.linkedin:
Where you open is a real estate decision, not just a retail one.

Every new location runs through the same steps: the site, the lease, the buildout, opening day. After the Wiz, I moved into waterfront revitalization and real estate development, assembling underutilized parcels across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and New Jersey.

Five questions before you sign: Who passes by, and who stops? What does the lease lock in? How will customers get here? What will the buildout take? Can we run the space well?

#RealEstate #Retail

Which question do you wish you'd asked earlier?
